notes.title: CrossOver: Roll For Initiative releasing on July 23rd!
notes.notes:
My new game "[b]CrossOver: Roll For Initiative[/b]" finally has its release date, and it's less than 2 weeks away! There is a free demo and WISHLISTING the game would [i]really[/i] help me out. Thanks for taking a look!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713080/CrossOver_Roll_For_Initiative/

CrossOver is a bizarre mashup of game styles into a frantic puzzle/action/RPG. With its retro stylings (pixel monsters! '80s bedroom! Classic Fighting Fantasy interludes!) it could definitely appeal to those of you who enjoyed playing Amicade. It even has a little hidden shooter minigame that I know you'll dig ;)

notes.title: Amicade v1.0.3
notes.notes:
There's been some great feedback and requests from the first weekend of Amicade competition, so I've made a few tweaks:

[list]
[*] [b]Pause Mode added[/b] - this was requested by a few people and at first I though, "You can't pause an arcade machine!" but after seeing how high the Shark Park score has grown, I think it's now needed. TAB key or X button pauses/unpauses.
[*] [b]Astro Clash improved late-game[/b] - for some reason I thought the difficulty infinitely scaled; it doesn't, but it may as well have because the difficulty cap was monstrous. I've lowered it slightly so that the late game of Astro Clash is more enjoyable and skill-based instead of primarily luck. This will mean much bigger scores are possible, so it's open slather again!
[*] [b]Quit current run using gamepad[/b] (mainly for Steam Deck users) - you can now do this from the pause menu. Note that Escape key no longer quits, do it from pause instead.
[*] [b]Shark Park tweak[/b] - I added a small minimum gap between when each shark is possible to first appear (the dreaded "Daa-dah" sound). This makes less crazy situations possible early in the game, however it won't impact the late game at all so top scoring is unaffected.
[*] [b]Astro Clash restart delay[/b] - a few players noted that when they are holding the fire button down and die, they sometimes don't let go of fire quick enough and a new game starts without seeing their previous score. I added a bigger delay until you can restart to better avoid this.
[*] [b]Amicade remembers which game you last played[/b] - upon request, when you return to the menu screen (or boot Amicade), the coin slot of the last game you played will be automatically selected.
[/list]
